segments.name: Independent Living
products: concierge and personal assistance/private duty services
segments.description: Operates owned or leased independent living communities for middle to upper income seniors who want a residential setting without the efforts of ownership.
segments.evidence: The Company's Independent Living segment includes owned or leased communities that are primarily designed for middle to upper income seniors who desire to live in a residential setting that feels like home, without the efforts of ownership.

segments.name: Assisted Living and Memory Care
segments.description: Provides housing and round-the-clock assistance with activities of daily living, plus specialized memory care for residents with dementia and cognitive impairment.
segments.evidence: The Company's Assisted Living and Memory Care segment includes owned or leased communities that offer housing and 24-hour assistance with activities of daily living for the Company's residents.

segments.name: CCRCs
segments.description: Operates large continuing care retirement communities where seniors can move among independent living, assisted living, memory care and skilled nursing as needs change.
segments.evidence: Most of the Company's CCRCs have independent living, assisted living, memory care, and skilled nursing available on one campus.

segments.name: All Other
products: reimbursements of costs incurred on behalf of managed communities
segments.description: Manages communities for third-party owners under management agreements, earning management fees and reimbursement of expenses it incurs for owners.
segments.evidence: All Other includes communities operated by the Company pursuant to management agreements.

revenueModel.text: Residents pay monthly fees for housing, care and services, with most revenue from private pay residents and the remainder from government and other payor programs.
revenueModel.evidence: For the year ended December 31, 2025, we generated 93.9% of our resident fee revenue from private pay residents, 4.8% from government reimbursement programs (primarily Medicaid and Medicare), and 1.3% from other payor sources.

changes.text: In 2025 the company exited a block of leased communities whose leases were terminated rather than renewed, and continued selling non-strategic owned communities.
changes.evidence: The leases for the remaining 55 communities (6,125 units) ("Non-renewal Communities") were terminated during 2025, with such terminations commencing on September 1, 2025.
